up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity rows for standard_type 'IC50' against target CHEMBL2169716 where activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then assay ChEMBL ID. Filter on target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2169716', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Join activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures on their respective keys (assay_id, tid, molregno).
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2169716'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
